# tools: add gnupg as alternative of gpg-suite

Compare plain [GnuPG](https://www.gnupg.org) from Homebrew with the GPG Suite cask the dotfiles install for commit signing ([[DOT-224]]). **Motivation:** "compare and define rationale" — GPG Suite brings a GUI keychain and a macOS pinentry, `gnupg` + `pinentry-mac` is the lighter, scriptable equivalent.
